entries.zh: 十二片确定性雷区，每一步都能由数字约束推出，不需要概率猜测。
entries.en: Twelve deterministic minefields. Every move can be deduced from the number constraints; no probability guessing needed.

entries.zh: 数字只统计周围八格中的地雷
entries.en: A number counts only the mines in the eight surrounding cells

entries.zh: 已公开区域和信标扫描结果固定
entries.en: Revealed areas and beacon scan results are fixed

entries.zh: 提示只使用当前盘面可证明的结论
entries.en: Hints use only conclusions provable from the current board
Two beacons open up the basic zero zones.

entries.zh: 狭长货舱要求从两端合并线索。
entries.en: A long narrow hold means combining clues from both ends.

entries.zh: 三处扫描区共同约束中段雷群。
entries.en: Three scan areas together constrain the mine cluster in the middle.

entries.zh: 缺失的四角不会参与数字统计。
entries.en: The four missing corners do not count toward numbers.

entries.zh: 残骸空洞切断部分邻接关系。
entries.en: Wreckage holes cut some of the neighbour links.

entries.zh: 中央禁区形成环形推导链。
entries.en: A central exclusion zone forms a ring of deductions.

entries.zh: 竖向裂谷只在两处门洞连通。
entries.en: A vertical rift connects only through two gateways.

entries.zh: 离散空洞让边界数字更重要。
entries.en: Scattered holes make the border numbers matter more.

entries.zh: 对称缺口隐藏着非对称雷区。
entries.en: Symmetric gaps hide an asymmetric minefield.

entries.zh: 外环与内环的约束必须交替推进。
entries.en: The outer and inner ring constraints must be advanced in turn.

entries.zh: 高密度残骸区需要集合包含推导。
entries.en: A dense wreckage field needs subset-inclusion deductions.

entries.zh: 最终航图组合全部异形边界与高密度约束。
entries.en: The final chart combines every irregular border with dense constraints.

entries.zh: 周围的地雷已经全部标记
entries.en: : all of its surrounding mines are already flagged

entries.zh: 的所有未明邻格都必须是雷
entries.en: : all of its hidden neighbours must be mines

entries.zh: 两个数字约束相减后，该格必定安全
entries.en: Subtracting two number constraints, this cell must be safe

entries.zh: 两个数字约束相减后，该格必定为雷
entries.en: Subtracting two number constraints, this cell must be a mine
The logic solver produced a contradiction

entries.zh: 初始信标区已公开。沿数字边界推进，整张航图都存在确定性下一步。
entries.en: The starting beacon area is revealed. Advance along the number borders; the whole chart always has a deterministic next step.

entries.zh: 探针触雷，护盾吸收冲击并自动标记该格。无误星章已经失去。
entries.en: The probe hit a mine; a shield absorbed the blast and flagged the cell. The flawless star is lost.

entries.zh: 护盾耗尽，雷区完整公开，可以重新勘测本任务。
entries.en: Shields depleted; the minefield is fully revealed. You can re-survey this mission.

entries.zh: 格，新的数字边界已经形成。
entries.en: cells; new number borders have formed.

entries.zh: 该格安全，继续沿数字约束推进。
entries.en: This cell is safe; keep advancing along the number constraints.

entries.zh: 当前标记与数字约束矛盾：高亮旗帜需要撤回。
entries.en: The current flags contradict the numbers: the highlighted flag needs to be undone.

entries.zh: 当前盘面没有可用推导；检查是否遗漏了已有数字周围的标记。
entries.en: No deduction is available on the current board; check for missing flags around existing numbers.

entries.zh: 正在按最后一次通关记录复盘探测与标记。
entries.en: Replaying the probes and flags from your last clear.

entries.zh: 回放结束；点击重新勘测可开始新的解题记录。
entries.en: Replay finished; click Re-survey to start a new solving record.
